description: Co-op input probe (gate G1). Observation only: no retail behaviour is changed.

_why: OSInit's retail path loads __ArenaLo from the lis/addi immediate pair at
0x80099B54 and passes it to OSSetArenaLo. The second OSSetArenaLo path at
0x80099B8C only runs on a debug boot (BootInfo->arenaLo == 0 and
Placing the co-op block at the arena base and raising that immediate past
it means the game's own allocator can never hand out the reserved region.
This is a derived reservation, not an address that merely looks unused.

hooks.name: poll_fn_800F7F64
hooks.note: stwu r1,-0x20(r1) at the per-pad poll boundary. Displaced instruction is re-executed by the trampoline, which then resumes at 0x800F7F68.

hooks.name: register_fn_800F80B0
hooks.note: lis r4, lbl_80401C10@ha at the pad allocator entry. Counts registration attempts per logical ID.
